methods.label: Find the intercepted arc
methods.explanation:
Angle \(ABC\) intercepts the arc \(AC\) that does not contain \(B\), so we first find the central angle over that arc.

[Figure 1](figures/2007_AMC_10B_Q04_question_fig1.svg)

The three angles around \(O\) make a full turn. Thus the central angle corresponding to this arc is
\[
\angle AOC=360^\circ-140^\circ-120^\circ=100^\circ.
\]
An inscribed angle equals half the central angle over the same arc. Therefore
\[
\angle ABC=\frac{100^\circ}{2}=\boxed{50^\circ},
\]
which is choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
